summary: A Doha advocacy and arbitration firm appears to lose enquiries to a WhatsApp link that looks wrong, filler text and no contact form.

findings.problem: The WhatsApp button appears to link to wa.me/30796666, which does not match the listed number 6666 3079 with the 974 code.
findings.cost: A client who taps WhatsApp may reach no one, and you never see the lost enquiry.
findings.fix: The correct full number in the WhatsApp link.

findings.problem: Placeholder Lorem ipsum text appears in the page content.
findings.cost: Filler text on a law firm site signals an unfinished build to corporate clients.
findings.fix: Real practice copy in every panel.

findings.problem: No contact form appears on the page, only a phone, an email and social links.
findings.cost: Many clients prefer to leave details at night and do not call.
findings.fix: A short enquiry form with matter type and phone.

findings.problem: The same welcome heading appears four times and the footer appears to read Copyright 2025.
findings.cost: Repeats and an old year make the site feel unmaintained.
findings.fix: One clear headline and a current footer.
